title: Updating the inner count
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $13$ of its register vector by $z$ yields the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its inner count $cnt$ by $z$.
replaced:
For any state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, updating the vector associated with
$\sigma$ at register index $13$ to $z$ gives the vector associated with the state
obtained from $\sigma$ by replacing its inner count $\mathrm{cnt}$ with $z$.
